Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original promotional concept cover for Crumb & Hearth, a warm editorial bakery landing-page prototype in a premium software portfolio.
Primary request: an inviting editorial food photograph centred on two beautifully golden butter croissants with delicately flaking layers and a small rustic sourdough loaf, arranged naturally on parchment and soft cream linen on a warm wood bakery counter.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet artisan bakery in soft morning window light; warm cream plaster softly out of focus, a restrained rust-toned ceramic plate and a few natural bread crumbs, no people.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, intimate medium close-up, strong central pastry silhouette that reads clearly as a small carousel cover, calm uncluttered lower third for a later HTML caption overlay. Match a refined set of photographic portfolio covers.
Lighting/mood: generous gentle side light, warm but natural colour, beautifully tactile food photography; comforting craftsmanship, no excessive styling.
Color palette: warm paper #f8f5ed, chocolate brown #34271f, rust #a44c2b, golden butter #e8bd82.
Materials/textures: flaky laminated pastry, crackled sourdough crust, parchment fibres, linen weave, honest wood grain; subtle natural imperfections.
Constraints: this is promotional artwork, not a website screenshot. No lettering, no logos, no watermark, no browser frame, no graphic labels, no collage, no extra utensils or decorative flourishes.
